purpose: Validate the statically recovered Game_FrameUpdateLoop call sequence and identify runtime scheduler-latch writers on a clean Level 01 replay.
working_tree_at_capture: scheduler instrumentation committed; unrelated untracked mame/ captures were left untouched

segments.input: player-run manifest: first-level boot followed by right movement

result: The active Level 01 replay executes all 37 recovered direct Game_FrameUpdateLoop call sites in the recovered order for 209 complete gameplay passes. The only direct AnimationVM_TickActors call is ordinal 30 at 0x001A8CCE, after SceneScript_AdvanceState; no second direct animation pass appears before MovementVM_TickActors. The frame counter is written by 0x001A8C1E at each observed gameplay pass. VBlank synchronization repeatedly returns through 0x001B2470. FRAME_WAIT_LATCH has no gameplay writer in this route; its observed non-reset writer is pre-gameplay at 0x001AA3B0.
limitations: The campaign validates the direct gameplay loop, not every indirect or scene-specific caller of the recovered services.
The final capture ends partway through the next call sequence because the requested 1400-frame window ends at ordinal 14.
Native probe_animation remains a provisional diagnostic phase and is not promoted by this evidence.
next_action: Trace the FRAME_WAIT_LATCH producer across a transition/resource campaign, then compare native causal scheduler output against the validated ROM call boundaries.
